# Navodaya Design and Contract

> Interior and architecture design, contracting and project management firm in New Delhi. Designed and built under one roof.

Navodaya Design and Contract Pvt Ltd is a design-and-build practice based at Mohan Cooperative Industrial Estate, Badarpur, New Delhi. The firm runs three equal practices: interior and architecture design, contracting, and project management. Work covers homes, offices and commercial spaces across Delhi NCR.

- Site: https://www.navodayagroup.com
- Contact: https://www.navodayagroup.com/contact
- Email: admin@navodayagroup.in
- Phone: +91 98710 23184
